시편 148:1.content: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the Lord from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

시편 148:2.content: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

시편 148:3.content: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

시편 148:4.content: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.

시편 148:5.content: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he commanded, and they were created.

시편 148:6.content: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

시편 148:7.content: Praise the Lord from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

시편 148:8.content: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

시편 148:9.content: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

시편 148:10.content: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

시편 148:11.content: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

시편 148:12.content: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

시편 148:13.content: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

시편 148:14.content: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord.
